title: C2A2 Heartbeat — community/user preference lens
description: One reader's lens over the Heartbeat. Backs BOTH the client-side per-device store (localStorage key 'c2a2_hb_prefs_v1') and the per-account row (Supabase public.user_preferences.prefs). The same document upgrades from device-local to account-synced at sign-in with no shape change. Operationalizes the tab's Community Lens view: filtering, ranking, communication, consent.

lens.description: Filtering lens — which signals are shown at all.

sources.description: Include-only source names; empty = all sources.

keywords.description: Free-text include terms; a signal must match at least one (empty = no keyword filter).

ranking.description: Ranking criteria — order of the shown signals.

priority_tags.description: Tags that boost a signal's effective rank.

priority_boost.description: Added to relevance per matched priority tag when sort = relevance.

communication.description: How digests reach the reader (display-only until Phase 2b accounts + notification wiring).

consent.description: Consent boundaries — gates every write/contribution path (Phase 3). All default false; nothing leaves the instance without an explicit opt-in.
